tips.text: The UK FCDO says the cyclone season normally runs from November to April, with coastal areas particularly at risk; storms can cut access to remote parts of the country and contaminate water supplies.

Canada's travel advice says the military took over on 14 October 2025 after large-scale demonstrations and announced a two-year transition. Demonstrations are frequent and can turn violent: avoid them and large gatherings, and follow local news.
Canada's travel advice says cash can be withdrawn from only a limited number of ATMs in Antananarivo and that some banks will not convert ariary back into hard currency.

The UK FCDO says road conditions vary greatly and are often poor, advises against driving at night, and says many secondary roads are impassable except by 4-wheel-drive in the December–April rainy season. It also warns of armed robberies on main roads, particularly at night.

Canada's travel advice says there is a risk of malaria in certain areas and at certain times of year, and that antimalarial medication may be recommended depending on your itinerary — see a health professional before you travel and use insect repellent.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Madagascar?
faq.answer: Yes: every nationality is eligible for the tourist eVisa, which you can apply for online in advance at evisamada-mg.com or at the eVisa counters on arrival. It comes in 15-, 30- and 60-day versions, with the fee depending on length of stay.

faq.question: How much does the Madagascar visa cost?
faq.answer: The official eVisa portal lists EUR 30 (USD 35) for up to 15 days, EUR 35 (USD 41) for 16–30 days and EUR 40 (USD 47) for 31–60 days.

faq.question: Should I get the eVisa or a visa on arrival?
faq.answer: Both give the same single-entry tourist visa, and the official portal says online prices are the same as those paid on arrival. If you apply online (between one week and six months before departure), the travel authorisation is issued within 72 hours and you present it at the eVisa counters on arrival; otherwise you can make the application at those counters when you land.

faq.question: Can I extend my stay in Madagascar?
faq.answer: The official eVisa portal's FAQ says that if you wish to stay more than 60 days you can extend your visa at the Immigration office, up to 90 days in total.

faq.question: Is Madagascar safe to visit?
faq.answer: Canada's travel advice says petty crime is common throughout the country, that violent crime is reported in all regions, and that armed gangs have assaulted tourists in isolated areas such as beaches and national parks. Demonstrations are frequent and can turn violent, and the UK FCDO says the cyclone season normally runs from November to April.

faq.question: When is the best time to visit Madagascar?
faq.answer: No official source we could read gives seasonal guidance for visitors. The UK FCDO says the cyclone season normally runs from November to April and that many secondary roads are impassable except by 4-wheel-drive in the December–April rainy season.
